idx_notif_jobs_dedup: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_notif_jobs_dedup ON public.notification_jobs USING btree (tenant_id, deduplication_key) WHERE ((deduplication_key IS NOT NULL) AND ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('pending'::character varying)::text, ('processing'::character varying)::text, ('completed'::character varying)::text])))
